lessons.title: Hana's birthday
lessons.description: Choose a gift, follow who gave what to whom, and distinguish a small budget from an unexpectedly high price.
lessons.canDo: Follow a gift-planning message thread and explain who gave or received a present

grammar.title: Follow the giver and receiver
grammar.formation: Giver は/が + receiver に + thing を + あげる. Giver は/が + me/my side に + thing を + くれる. Receiver は/が + giver に/から + thing を + もらう.
grammar.explanation: The verb chooses the viewpoint. 私はハナさんに本をあげました puts me as giver. ハナさんは私に本をくれました describes a gift coming towards me. 私はハナさんから本をもらいました makes me the receiver. くれる can also refer to a gift to someone on my side; the viewpoint must be clear. Use ordinary forms with friends, not to describe respectful giving to a superior.
grammar.example: レンさんから本をもらいました。
grammar.translation: I received a book from Ren.

examples.ja: {去年|きょねん}、ハナさんに{本|ほん}をあげました。
examples.en: Last year I gave Hana a book.

examples.ja: ハナさんが{私|わたし}に{花|はな}をくれました。
ハナさんは{両親|りょうしん}から{財布|さいふ}をもらいました。
examples.en: Hana received a wallet from her parents.

grammar.mistake: If 私 is the subject of もらいました, I received something. Do not reverse the giver and receiver merely because both are people.

grammar.title: Wanting, guessing and suggesting
grammar.formation: Thing が + 欲しい. Plain form + かもしれません (noun / な-adjective: omit だ). Verb た-form + らどうですか.
grammar.explanation: 欲しい expresses the speaker's wish for a thing. Ask another person's wish rather than asserting it without evidence. かもしれません marks uncertainty: 花が好きかもしれません means they may like flowers. 送ったらどうですか suggests sending something; it is not a statement that the sending already happened. Suggestions can sound intrusive, so use them in an appropriate relationship.
grammar.example: 花を送ったらどうですか。

examples.ja: ハナさんは{何|なに}が{欲|ほ}しいですか。
examples.en: What does Hana want? (a question about her wish)

examples.ja: {花|はな}が{好|す}きかもしれません。
レンさんに{聞|き}いたらどうですか。

grammar.mistake: A guess needs かもしれません; it is not certain evidence. Use 送ったら, not 送るたら. 欲しい is for a thing; wanting to do something uses ～たい.

grammar.title: Only this much; as much as that
grammar.formation: Number + しか + negative predicate (千円しかありません). Number + も + predicate (一万円もします).
grammar.explanation: しか frames the amount as limited and requires a negative predicate, even though the English sentence is positive: I have only 1,000 yen. Number + も can emphasise an unexpectedly large amount: it costs as much as 10,000 yen. Ordinary number + あります states an amount without either evaluation.

examples.ja: {予算|よさん}は{千円|せんえん}しかありません。
examples.en: We have a budget of only 1,000 yen.

examples.ja: その{財布|さいふ}は{一万円|いちまんえん}もします。
examples.en: That wallet costs as much as 10,000 yen.

examples.ja: {一週間|いっしゅうかん}に{一回|いっかい}しか{働|はたら}けません。
examples.en: I can work only once a week.

grammar.mistake: 千円しかあります is incorrect here: しか needs ありません. Number + も in the price example signals the speaker's judgement of the amount.

dialogues.title: Choosing the present
dialogues.scene: You and Ren plan Hana's birthday present. Money is limited, and neither person is sure what she wants.

lines.speaker: Ren
lines.line: {明日|あした}はハナさんの{誕生日|たんじょうび}ですね。プレゼントはどうしますか。
lines.romaji: Ashita wa Hana-san no tanjōbi desu ne. Purezento wa dō shimasu ka.
lines.meaning: Tomorrow is Hana's birthday, isn't it? What shall we do about a present?

lines.speaker: You
lines.line: {予算|よさん}は{千円|せんえん}しかありません。アルバイトで{働|はたら}ける{時間|じかん}がまだあまりありませんから。
lines.romaji: Yosan wa sen'en shika arimasen. Arubaito de hatarakeru jikan ga mada amari arimasen kara.
lines.meaning: My budget is only 1,000 yen. I don't have much time to work at my part-time job yet.

lines.speaker: Ren
lines.line: {授業|じゅぎょう}もありますからね。{花|はな}をあげたらどうですか。
lines.romaji: Jugyō mo arimasu kara ne. Hana o agetara dō desu ka.
lines.meaning: You have classes too, after all. Why don't you give her flowers?

lines.speaker: You
lines.line: いいですね。ハナさんは{花|はな}が{好|す}きかもしれません。
lines.romaji: Ii desu ne. Hana-san wa hana ga suki kamoshiremasen.
lines.meaning: That's a good idea. Hana might like flowers.

lines.speaker: Ren
lines.line: その{財布|さいふ}はどうですか。
lines.romaji: Sono saifu wa dō desu ka.

lines.speaker: You
lines.line: {一万円|いちまんえん}もします。{私|わたし}の{予算|よさん}では{買|か}えません。
lines.romaji: Ichiman'en mo shimasu. Watashi no yosan de wa kaemasen.
lines.meaning: It costs as much as 10,000 yen. I can't buy it with my budget.

lines.speaker: Ren
lines.line: では、{千円|せんえん}の{花|はな}を{選|えら}びましょう。
lines.romaji: Dewa, sen'en no hana o erabimashō.

dialogues.title: At the birthday gathering
dialogues.scene: You give Hana flowers at Ren's café. She explains which gifts she received from different people.

lines.speaker: You
lines.line: ハナさん、お{誕生日|たんじょうび}おめでとうございます。この{花|はな}、どうぞ。
lines.romaji: Hana-san, o-tanjōbi omedetō gozaimasu. Kono hana, dōzo.
lines.meaning: Happy birthday, Hana. These flowers are for you.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.line: ありがとうございます。{初|はじ}めて{花|はな}をもらいました。きれいですね。
lines.romaji: Arigatō gozaimasu. Hajimete hana o moraimashita. Kirei desu ne.
lines.meaning: Thank you. This is the first time I've received flowers. They're beautiful.

lines.speaker: You
lines.line: レンさんからもプレゼントをもらいましたか。
lines.romaji: Ren-san kara mo purezento o moraimashita ka.
lines.meaning: Did you receive a present from Ren too?

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.line: はい。レンさんは{本|ほん}をくれました。{両親|りょうしん}からは{財布|さいふ}をもらいました。
lines.romaji: Hai. Ren-san wa hon o kuremashita. Ryōshin kara wa saifu o moraimashita.
lines.meaning: Yes. Ren gave me a book. I received a wallet from my parents.

lines.speaker: You
lines.line: {私|わたし}もその{財布|さいふ}が{欲|ほ}しいです。{今度|こんど}、ほかのアルバイトを{探|さが}します。{時給|じきゅう}はもっと{高|たか}いほうがいいです。
lines.romaji: Watashi mo sono saifu ga hoshii desu. Kondo, hoka no arubaito o sagashimasu. Jikyū wa motto takai hō ga ii desu.
lines.meaning: I'd like that wallet too. Next time I'll look for another part-time job. I'd prefer higher hourly pay.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.line: {去年|きょねん}、ユイさんに{手袋|てぶくろ}をあげました。その{色|いろ}が{似合|にあ}っていました。
lines.romaji: Kyonen, Yui-san ni tebukuro o agemashita. Sono iro ga niatte imashita.
lines.meaning: Last year I gave Yui gloves. That colour suited her.

lines.speaker: You
lines.line: そうですか。ユイさんも{喜|よろこ}んだかもしれませんね。
lines.romaji: Sō desu ka. Yui-san mo yorokonda kamoshiremasen ne.
lines.meaning: I see. Yui may have been pleased too.

glosses.meaning: you; the learner's label in this thread

grammar: あげる / くれる / もらう
watch.prompt: Optionally find a gift or favour exchange in your own material. Save one line and label giver, receiver and viewpoint. A speaker's wish or guess is not proof of another person's feelings.

exercises.prompt: How much can you spend on a gift?
exercises.explain: 予算は千円しかありません states a limited budget of 1,000 yen.

exercises.prompt: Why do you currently have limited earnings?
options: You don't have much time to work yet
exercises.explain: 働ける時間がまだあまりありませんから directly gives the reason: little available time to work.
両親からは財布をもらいました: she received it from her parents.

exercises.prompt: Who received gloves from Hana last year?
exercises.explain: ユイさんに手袋をあげました names Yui as the recipient.

exercises.context: You want a wallet. Choose the reply that states that wish.
options: {財布|さいふ}をなくしました。
{財布|さいふ}が{欲|ほ}しいです。
exercises.explain: 財布が欲しいです states a wish for the thing.

exercises.line: {明日|あした}、{花|はな}を{選|えら}びませんか。
exercises.context: You have class tomorrow and can go today. Choose that reply.
options: {明日|あした}はいつでも{行|い}けます。
{明日|あした}は{授業|じゅぎょう}があります。{今日|きょう}なら{行|い}けます。
exercises.explain: This reply explains the clash with class and offers today as the available case.
しか requires a negative predicate: ありません.

exercises.context: Say you received a gift from your parents.
exercises.line: {両親|りょうしん}からプレゼントを＿＿。
exercises.explain: With you as receiver and 両親から marking the giver, use もらいました.

exercises.prompt: You are not sure whether Hana likes flowers. Which keeps that uncertainty?
options: {花|はな}が{好|す}きかもしれません。
exercises.explain: かもしれません explicitly marks the statement as a possibility.
送る becomes the た-form 送った; add らどうですか to suggest the action.

exercises.prompt: What kind of job do you say you will look for?
exercises.explain: 時給はもっと高いほうがいいです states a preference for higher hourly pay.

exercises.prompt: Which gift does Hana say she has received for the first time?
exercises.explain: 初めて花をもらいました states this explicitly.

exercises.prompt: When will you and Ren meet?
exercises.explain: The final message settles on 今日の午後三時.
花をあげたらどうですか proposes flowers.

exercises.prompt: Which price fits the stated maximum budget?
exercises.explain: 千円しかありません sets the available budget at 1,000 yen.

exercises.prompt: Where is the agreed meeting place?
exercises.explain: The final message says カフェで.
